paragraphs: Hoshaya. Rav Acha, his son. Rabbi Abba bar Mammal asked him; Abba bar Tachlifa in his name; Rabbi Oshaya son of Rabbi Chiyya. Rabbi Achi in his name. He reported in Rabbi Acha’s name (Berakhot 3b). He reported in Rabbi Elazar’s name—perhaps this was the second Oshaya. Rabbi Elazar in his name concerns Oshaya the great. Rabbi Elazar, Rabbi Yitzchak’s father, in his name. He asked Rabbi Ammi; said in Rabbi Assi’s name; Rabbi Assi in his name; Rabbi Bon bar Kahana; Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yannai. He asked Rav Huna; sent Zavda ben Levi. Rabbi Zeira in his name; Rabbi Ze'ira asked him; Rabbi Chagga in his name. Before Rabbi Chiyya; Rabbi Chiyya bar Yosef in his name; Rabbi Chiyya bar Lulini; Rabbi Chiyya Totri; Rabbi Chilkiyah in his name; Rabbi Chama bar Yosef, his student; Rabbi Chama, Kappara’s father; Rabbi Chama bar Chanina; Rabbi Chanina bar Chama, Rabbi Chiyya the elder’s colleague; Chanina of Carthage; Rabbi Chananyah, son of Rabbi Hoshaya’s brother. In Rabbi’s name, Arvei Pesachim 113. He asked Rabbi Yehudah Haggazzar. Rabbi Yehudah Nesia (see above); Rav Yehudah (see above); Rabbi Yehudah bar Safra. Rabbi Yochanan asked him; Rabbi Yonah in his name; Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina, his nephew. Rav Yosef in his name; Rabbi Yosef bar Chama in his name. He said in Rabbi Yannai’s name. Rabbi Yaakov in his name; Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha; Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi in his name; Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chakula; Rabbi Yitzchak bar Nachmani in his name. Mar bar Rav Ashi—Rav Oshaya spoke to him. Rav Simon Detari in his name. Rabbi Safra told him, “By Moses! Is what you said really right?” Ulla in his name; he objected to Ulla. Rabbi Pedat in his name; Rabbi Pinchas in his name. In Rav’s name, Sanhedrin 38, end of a. Before Rava (see above). Resh Lakish’s teacher, and he speaks in his name. Rabbi Shimon ben Yosini; Rabbi Shmuel bar Chanina in his name; Rabbi Shmuel bar Abba of Hagrunya before him; Rabbi Toma bar Pappos in his name.
